instruction.text: There are many different types of games. Select the correct image to match the type of game.

hint.text: PEGI stands for Pan-European Game Information. It is the content rating system used in Europe to assign age recommendations to video games.
hint.label: PEGI

atoms.b: Not every game is suitable for ((++every_age every_height)). Therefore, there’s an organisation that gives ((++age_ratings awards)) to games. This organisation is called PEGI.
Numbers from 0 to ((++18 99)) represent the age rating. This is not only for games, but also for other content such as films and music.

instruction.text: Are these statements true or false?

atoms.a: The age rating can help me identify games that are appropriate for my age.
I can play games with a PEGI 18 rating at the age of 10. There’s nothing to worry about.
Games with a PEGI 3 rating are only for little kids.
At the age of 9, I should only play games with a PEGI 3 and 7 rating.
Even if a game is approved for my age according to PEGI, I should still ask an adult if it’s suitable for me.

instruction.text: Match the dangers being described to the situations.

atoms.a: Jonas was repeatedly insulted and threatened by an anonymous person in an online game.

end.text: Bullying is when someone repeatedly threatens, insults or targets another person. When it happens in the online world, it is called cyberbullying.
end.sound: Bullying is when someone repeatedly threatens, insults or targets another person. When it happens in the online world, it is called cyber-bullying.

atoms.a: Daisy plays online games for at least 4 hours every day and neglects doing her homework.
Can accidentally used his parents’ money to buy a new hat for his character in a game.
atoms.sound: Chahn accidentally used his parents’ money to buy a new hat for his character in a game.

instruction.text: Read the situation and select the correct answer.

atoms.a: Chloé wants to buy an outfit for her new character in a game. What should she do?
b: ++She should always ask her parents first if she’s allowed to buy something.
If it’s not that expensive, she can just buy it.

feedback.end: In-game purchases can quickly become very expensive. You should always pay close attention to what you’re buying in an app or game.

atoms.a: Jamal has to wait a day in his free game before he can play the next level. However, he could also buy 3 diamonds to play it immediately. What should he do?
b: It’s only 3 diamonds. He can just buy them.
++He should be careful, because the diamonds cost real money.

feedback.end: Games attempt to hide real costs beneath game currencies, such as diamonds.

atoms.a: Caroline plays her new game the whole day and neglects her family, friends and schoolwork as a result. What could she do to free up time for other things?
b: If the game is a lot of fun, she should just keep playing.
++She could set a time limit in the game to have better control over the amount of time she plays.

feedback.end: It’s very easy to lose track of time when you’re playing games. That means it’s important to set yourself a limit, so you don’t neglect doing important things.
